summary: Phase4 loops are bounded: provider status loads once per modal reload, model fetches are one-shot per provider cache entry, fuzzy filtering is local, and chip expansion is user-controlled.

guardrails: Do not request include_models by default
Do not attempt credential actions on load failure
loops.state_updates: Writes providers, active selection, oauth provider options

loops.purpose: Lazy fetch one provider model list
entry_conditions: A provider is selected or expanded
Provider is not already cached or loading
exit_conditions: An empty list and warning are cached
Provider was already cached or loading
loops.feedback_signal: ModelSelect loading state and field warning
loops.failure_policy: Cache empty list, display warning, allow manual model ID

guardrails: Sort by deterministic score and id
Keyboard selection remains bounded by filtered length
loops.feedback_signal: Dropdown option list and highlight index
loops.failure_policy: Keep the typed text as the emitted model value

exit_conditions: Provider id is added to or removed from expandedChips
guardrails: Expanded list has max-height and scroll
loops.state_updates: Writes MEM-004 and may trigger LOOP-002
loops.failure_policy: No persistent side effect; user can collapse or close modal

guardrails: Failed checks must be fixed and rerun
Generated assets must match frontend build
loops.feedback_signal: Command exit codes and payload probe output
loops.state_updates: Writes verification, release, and handoff evidence
loops.failure_policy: Record blocker rather than claiming success

retry_budget: Provider load and each provider model fetch run once per relevant user action/cache state. There is no polling or background retry for catalog search. Verification may rerun affected checks after fixes.
convergence: The UX converges when provider status renders compactly, selected provider models are either cached or manually typed, and chip lists remain bounded unless explicitly expanded.
human_escape_hatches: Close and reopen settings to clear the in-memory cache
Use /providers/{id}/models to inspect a provider catalog directly
observability: model_count is visible in API payloads
Loading and failure states are visible in ModelSelect fields
Tests and payload probe capture loop outcomes

tests.name: lazy-load-loop
tests.evidence: ProviderSettings ensureModels has cache and loading guards

tests.name: fuzzy-loop
tests.evidence: ModelSelect filters local models and caps visible results at 50

tests.name: verification-loop
tests.evidence: bun test, typechecks, frontend build, pytest, ruff, and payload probe passed
